lines: •Increased Subsea revenue guidance to a range of $9.6 - $9.8 billion for 2026
•Anticipate Subsea inbound orders over the next five quarters to be at least $14.5 billion, when including expectations for 2027

Pferdehirt concluded, “The robust pipeline of opportunities supports our expectation for further growth, and if we extend our view to include 2027, we expect Subsea orders over the next five quarters to be at least $14.5 billion.
